issues.argument: The claim asserts that because certain instrumental values increase the probability of goal realisation, they are 'likely to be pursued by many intelligent agents'. This is a non-sequitur unless the paper establishes that these agents are rational utility maximizers with the strategic foresight to identify these instrumental values. The provided text offers no such premise or argument.
